home.title: ChronoPay
home.description: Tokenize your future time slots as tradable digital assets on the Stellar network. Buy, sell, reserve, and redeem time globally.
home.heroTitle: Book, pay for and receipt time, on Stellar.
home.heroDescription: ChronoPay turns future time slots into tradable digital assets. Suppliers list availability, buyers book and pay, and both sides get a clear receipt and history.
home.demoNoticePrefix: Demo notice: all listings, suppliers, balances and receipts in this deployment are sample data. No real payments are processed. Live demo:

features.tokenizedSlotsBody: Suppliers publish availability as bookable slots; buyers reserve, hold and redeem them. Recurring availability and timezone-aware scheduling are built in.
features.stellarPaymentsBody: Wallet connection, XLM pricing, payout onboarding and refund-destination selection for a clear money trail.
features.receiptsBody: Every booking has a status timeline and a receipt page with notes, plus export of booking history.
features.dashboardBody: Overview metrics, wallet status, bookings, supplier profiles, ratings and reviews, notifications and settings.
features.pricingBody: Plan comparison and a pricing-strategy explainer so suppliers know what they earn.
features.accessibilityBody: Skip links, focus traps, keyboard shortcuts (press ?), light/dark themes and a documented design system.
